newsitem.title: JAPAN: M'bishi Elec to acquire stake in Hydro Quebec unit.
newsitem.headline: M'bishi Elec to acquire stake in Hydro Quebec unit.

text.p: Mitsubishi Electric Corp said on Thursday it would acquire a more than 15 percent stake in a unit of Hydro Quebec of Canada.
Mitsubishi Electric said it aims to enter the business of electric power system simulators, which help utilities to cut costs.
Mitsubishi said in a statement it expects its sales of simulators to reach a total of five billion yen over the next three years.
The Hydro Quebec unit is TEQSIM Inc, which specialises in electric power system simulators.
Mitsubishi said it will have the exclusive sales rights to TEQSIM simulators in Japan and will it will also market and sell them globally.
Electric power system simulators can provide precise simulations of electric power systems through small-scale tests, it said.
The simulators also help electric power companies to design equipment which can distribute electricity at a lower cost, it said.
